Mumbai faces water shortage amid heavy monsoon rains and waterlogging

Mumbai is experiencing a dual challenge of critically low water reserves in its key reservoirs, which are below 7% of capacity, and heavy monsoon rainfall causing significant waterlogging. The Indian Meteorological Department has forecast more rain, leading to disruptions like the closure of the Andheri subway. Authorities are addressing infrastructure issues related to waterlogging while the city grapples with its water supply situation.
